answer_1.quote: We assess the general performance of our trained models on a suite of benchmarks, including MMLU, HellaSwag, TruthfulQA, and GSM8K... We also evaluate robustness using the Harm-Bench safety benchmark, generating model responses to benign and harmful prompts.
answer_1.outputs: Model-generated responses to prompts (both benign and harmful) used for safety and capability evaluation.

answer_2.quote: We use the HarmBench classifier, a fine-tuned Llama 2 13B model providing a binary classification of harmfulness. We also report Attack Success Rate (ASR) and StrongREJECT classifier scores.
